info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Status API provides users with real-time information about current weather alerts. This endpoint allows consumers to fetch the status of various weather alerts issued in their area, thus enabling proactive responses to severe weather conditions. Typical users include meteorologists, emergency response teams, and application developers needing to integrate weather alert data into their platforms. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their decision-making processes and ensure the safety of their personnel and clients.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the current status of alerts. It provides a quick overview of all active and resolved alerts in the system, helping in monitoring and management tasks.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of alerts. This request allows the client to obtain the current status of alerts based on the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of alerts.
